text: Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a profound sense of altruism. Her primary motivation stems from a personal history, specifically the deadly disease that plagued her youth, which fuels her dedication to finding a cure. This motivation is characterized by resilience and determination, as she continues her work despite facing significant obstacles, including personal health setbacks and professional skepticism. Her character development highlights her capacity to maintain hope and perseverance in the face of overwhelming odds, underscoring her strength of will and commitment to her cause.
